notes: Whitman County Rural Library District Proposition No. 1 is scoped LIBDST 'L' (WA DOR LIB2025, layer 12): Pullman and the towns of Rosalia, Garfield, Endicott, Colton and Uniontown are outside the district, so it is not county-wide.
Cheney School District No. 360's two levies reach a small Whitman area north of St. John; DOR SCH2025 (layer 20) numbers that portion '316', so both are scoped SCHDST '316'.
